cases.name: continue-blocked-by-generated-files
cases.prompt:
Mid-rebase (9 commits), I resolved the conflict in commit 3 and `git rebase --continue` worked, but now it stops with:

    error: cannot rebase: You have unstaged changes.
    error: Please commit or stash them.

`git status` shows no unmerged paths; the only modified files are under `dist/`, which is tracked in the repo and gets rewritten by a file watcher that's running in another terminal. What do I do to finish the rebase without losing anything?
cases.trap: The blocker is dirty tracked non-conflicted files, not a conflict; tempting fixes are committing dist/ into a replayed commit with `git add -A`, `git rebase --skip`, `--abort`, or `git checkout -- dist` which discards changes.
expectations: Identifies the dirty tracked dist/ files as the blocker rather than a conflict
Suggests stopping the file watcher (or otherwise preventing further rewrites) while the rebase runs
Stashes only the dist/ path (e.g. `git stash push -- dist/`) then runs `git rebase --continue`
Tells the user to run `git stash pop` after the rebase finishes (not merely as an optional step) and to review or regenerate the dist/ content afterward
negative_expectations: Recommends `git add -A`/`git add .` to fold dist/ changes into a replayed commit
Offers `git checkout -- dist`/`git restore dist`/`git reset --hard` as an option at all, or says nothing is lost without telling the user to confirm dist/ is purely generated

cases.name: Conflict marker display
cases.prompt: I'm midway through a rebase. I want Git to show the common ancestor as well as both sides in conflict markers. Give the configuration command and tell me how to verify it before continuing.
cases.trap: Accidentally configures a nonexistent merge.conflictStyle value, breaking later conflicts.
expectations: Uses git config merge.conflictStyle zdiff3 on supported Git versions or diff3 on older ones.
Shows a read-back of the configured value and does not alter unrelated conflict state.
must_not: Never configures znew, znew diff3, or an unrelated value.
